reference_method: Two Codex agents each read five full fictional input pairs and the common taxonomy; root checked evidence and schema before any baseline or Gemini predictions on this set. This is editorial assistance within one AI system, not independent human adjudication.
scope: Five AI PM and five commercial PM fictional roles; preparation gaps only.
limitations: AI-authored judgments, not the student's personal review or correctness ground truth.
The same assistant family helped create fixtures, taxonomy and references; shared framing can inflate agreement.
References are fixed before predictions but remain small-sample, subjective labels.
Once suggestions are viewed, later student review of these cases is AI-assisted rather than blind.
The instructor's recommendation to personally check ten cases has not been completed.

judgments.jd_quote: They will define age-appropriate interaction rules, consent and escalation paths, and a clear way for users to report troubling answers.

alternative.reason_zh: 若将 JD 的重点解释为消费教育产品方向和学习价值定位，PRODUCT_STRATEGY 可替代第三项。JD 没有明说 PM 必须搭建 AI 评测体系，因此第三项的排序存在合理歧义。

judgments.jd_quote: They will define a roadmap for spend visibility, understandable limits, partner attribution, and pricing packages that support new industries without creating hidden costs or billing disputes.
judgments.profile_quote: During a referral campaign, sign-ups increased by 32 percent.
judgments.reason_zh: 岗位的核心是按量计费、套餐、预算可预期性和账单信任。候选人的拉新活动和增长报告是相关商业接触，但未提供定价、包装、计费或成本透明产品决策证据，32% 注册增长不能证明这些能力。应优先准备 AI 服务收费方案及其用户与财务后果。

judgments.jd_quote: The PM will write commercial product requirements and work with finance, legal, sales, design, analytics, and engineering on release decisions.

judgments.reason_zh: 候选人参加过规划讨论且能跨团队沟通，但明确没有 backlog 所有权。岗位要求将增长、信任和实现成本转为商业产品需求与发布取舍，因此需要补充路线图和范围决策的负责案例。这是 PM 的交付取舍能力，不要求候选人自行承担工程实现。
additional_jd_quotes: The candidate should be able to map the customer journey, test packaging with buyers, and make clear choices when growth opportunities conflict with trust or implementation cost.
